title: Al-Kafi fi Fiqh Ahl al-Madina
author: ibn-abd-al-barr
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Ibn 'Abd al-Barr's concise statement of Maliki law, giving for each question the position he judged best attested in the school and leaving out the long chains of dissent. It covers the whole law from purification to inheritance in a single readable volume.
historicalContext: Ibn 'Abd al-Barr was the leading hadith scholar of al-Andalus, best known for his commentaries on the Muwatta. He wrote al-Kafi as a practical handbook, and it remained a reference for Andalusian and North African judges.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
